svg.aria-label: Map of Ireland, Britain and Gaul showing the places of St Patrick: the wood of Foclut near Killala, Croagh Patrick, Lough Derg, the Hill of Slane, the Hill of Tara, Dublin, Auxerre and Lérins, places proposed for his birthplace in Britain, and an inset of Ulster with Slemish, Armagh, Saul and Downpatrick
svg.title: Map of Ireland, Britain and Gaul showing the places of St Patrick: the wood of Foclut near Killala, Croagh Patrick, Lough Derg, the Hill of Slane, the Hill of Tara, Dublin, Auxerre and Lérins, places proposed for his birthplace in Britain, and an inset of Ulster with Slemish, Armagh, Saul and Downpatrick

g.text: Wood of Foclut, near Killala: his captivity (one tradition)
Hill of Slane: the Easter fire (Muirchú)
Ulster: Slemish, Armagh, Saul, Downpatrick (see inset)
Arklow (Inber Dea): his landing, by Muirchú
places in his life and shrines
places proposed for Bannavem Taberniae, his home
Many sites are known from tradition; locations approximate.
Lérins: his studies, by another tradition
